description: The base images (php, node) are not pinned: the weekly build pulls the current ones of their tags.
Renovate tracks the versions of the Dockerfile defaults, to report new PHP and Node.js lines.

customManagers.description: Default PHP and Node.js versions in the Dockerfile, the newest of the build matrix

packageRules.description: Tracked by the custom manager instead: the dockerfile one reads them from the FROM lines with the ARG defaults filled in, a text it can't find to replace
Major and minor lines only: patch releases come with the weekly build
A new line goes into the build matrix too, which Renovate can't extend itself
prBodyNotes: Add this version to the matrix of `.github/workflows/build.yml` (and move `latest` to it), and update the tags in `README.md`. Drop versions that EspoCRM no longer supports or that reached end of life.

packageRules.description: Node.js: LTS lines only (even majors up to 26; every major is an LTS from 27 on, six months after its release: merge then)

description: One pull request for all non-major GitHub Actions updates (the linter images of lint.yml too), merged once the build passes.
Weekly, as Renovate itself releases several times a day.
The commits also keep the weekly schedule enabled, which GitHub disables after 60 days without activity.
